description: Look up one survey by its survey_id (from geode_surveys_get_available_surveys, geode_surveys_get_my_surveys or a shared link): its questions, payout per response and remaining capacity. Returns it only while it is open, i.e. funded, payout > 0 and under its response cap; a closed, unfunded or full survey (or an unknown id) comes back as an empty result. Read-only; no signature. Optional `caller`: the account whose view to read (for caller-dependent results).

caller.description: Optional account address (SS58) to run the query as

name: geode_surveys_get_survey_by_id
title: Surveys: get survey by id
